description.zh: 若使用弹性扩容，则必须设置为true。
description.en: Set the value to true if scale-outs are allowed.

description.zh: 应用ID。
description.en: The ID of the application.

description.zh: 部署分组ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance group to which the application is deployed.

description.zh:
触发条件。

- OR：任一条件
- AND：所有条件
description.en:
The relationship among the conditions that trigger a scale-in.

- OR: one of the conditions

- AND: all conditions

description.zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率。
description.en: The CPU utilization that triggers a scale-in.

description.zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟。
description.en: The duration in which the metric threshold is exceeded. Unit: minutes.

description.zh:
是否包含缩容规则。

- true：包含
- false：不包含
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow scale-ins.

- true: allows scale-ins.

- false: does not allow scale-ins.

description.zh: 分组缩容时需要保留的最小实例数。
description.en: The minimum number of instances that must be retained in each group when a scale-in is performed.

description.zh: 触发指标：系统负载。
description.en: The system load that triggers a scale-in.

description.zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0。
description.en: The minimum service latency that triggers a scale-in. The lower limit is 0. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 每次缩容的实例数。
description.en: The number of instances that are removed during each scale-in.

description.zh: 实例登录密钥名称。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效。
description.en: The key pair that is used to log on to the instance. This parameter takes effect only if you choose to create instances based on the specifications of an existing instance during a scale-out.

description.zh:
弹性扩容的多可用区扩缩容策略。包含两种策略：
- PRIORITY：优先级策略。
- BALANCE：均衡分布策略。
description.en:
The multi-zone scaling policy. Valid values:

- PRIORITY: The vSwitch that is first selected has the highest priority.

- BALANCE: This policy evenly distributes instances across zones in which the vSwitches reside.

description.zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率。
description.en: The CPU utilization that triggers a scale-out.

description.zh:
触发条件。

- OR：任一条件
- AND：所有条件
description.en:
The relationship among the conditions that trigger a scale-out.

- OR: one of the conditions

- AND: all conditions

description.zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟。
description.en: The duration in which the metric threshold is exceeded. Unit: minutes.

description.zh: 是否包含扩容规则。
description.en: Specifies whether to allow scale-outs.

description.zh: 分组扩容时的最大实例数。
description.en: The maximum number of instances in each group when a scale-out is performed.

description.zh: 触发指标：系统负载。
description.en: The system load that triggers a scale-out.

description.zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0。
description.en: The minimum service latency that triggers a scale-out. The lower limit is 0. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 每次扩容的实例数。
description.en: The number of instances that are added during each scale-out.

description.zh: 实例登录密码。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效。
description.en: The password that is used to log on to the instance. This parameter takes effect only if you choose to create instances based on the specifications of an existing instance during a scale-out.

description.zh:
扩容实例来源。
- NEW：弹性资源。
- AVAILABLE：已有资源。已有资源优先为AVAILABLE_FIRST。

NEW或AVAILABLE_FIRST需指定弹性扩容参数，弹性扩容包括两种模式：启动模版和基于现有实例规则。
description.en:
The source of the instance to be added during a scale-out. Valid values:

- NEW: elastic resources

- AVAILABLE: existing resources If you prefer existing resources to elastic resources, set this parameter to AVAILABLE\_FIRST.

If you set this parameter to NEW or AVAILABLE\_FIRST, you must specify the auto-scaling parameters. If you set this parameter to NEW, instances are created based on a launch template or the specifications of an existing instance.

description.zh:
弹性缩容的回收模式。
- release：释放模式
- recycle：停机回收模式。
description.en:
The instance handling mode during a scale-in. Valid values:

- release: When a scale-in is performed, instances that are no longer used are released.

- recycle: When a scale-in is performed, instances that are no longer used are stopped and reclaimed.

description.zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效，优先级高于TemplateInstanceId。
description.en: The ID of the launch template that is used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you set the OutEnable parameter to true. This parameter takes precedence over the TemplateInstanceId parameter.

description.zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效。
description.en: The ID of the instance whose specifications are used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter is valid only when you set the OutEnable parameter to true.

description.zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例名称。TemplateInstanceId存在才有效。
description.en: The name of the instance whose specifications are used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you specify the TemplateInstanceId parameter.

description.zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”版本。OutEnable为true（真）才有效。若使用默认模版，则设置为`-1`，否则设置为相应的版本号。
description.en: The version of the launch template that is used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you set the OutEnable parameter to true. To use the default template version, set this parameter to `-1`. Otherwise, set this parameter to the version that you want to use.

description.zh: VPC相关的vswitch ID列表，多个以半角逗号（,）分割。
description.en: The IDs of the vSwitches that are associated with the VPC. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 弹性扩容的“启动模版”或“基于现有实例规则”所关联的VPC ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that is associated with the instances created based on a launch template or the specifications of an existing instance.
